# Taste — fixture site

The judgment layer for this fixture. Tokens live in design.md.

## What we refuse

- Decorative gradients with no purpose. A gradient frames meaning or it leaves the page.
- Glassmorphism without imagery underneath.
- Animations on text. Type does not slide, fade, or scale in.

## Motion

One earned motion moment per page at most, and only when it demonstrates the
product. Under prefers-reduced-motion the still page tells the whole story.
